notes: Canonical URL per openai.com release sitemap: https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/ (the /index/gpt-5/ slug now 404s). Release date 2025-08-07 printed on page. All chart numbers machine-read from embedded vega-lite specs (balanced-JSON parse of the RSC payload; NOT OCR) and anchored against prose values (AIME 94.6 / SWE-bench Verified 74.9 / Aider 88 / MMMU 84.2 / HealthBench Hard 46.2 / GPQA pro 88.4). GPT-5 Pro replaces OpenAI o3-pro. Not turned into rows (documented here): Tau2-bench chart (per-domain with/without-thinking fractions stacked ambiguously in the payload); GPQA/AI-index-vs-thinking-budget line charts (sample-budget curves conflict with headline bars); hallucination-rate charts on LongFact/FActScore (GPT-5 thinking 0.7-1.0% vs o3 4.5-5.7%); response-level error rate on de-identified ChatGPT traffic (GPT-5 thinking 4.8% vs o3 22%); deception evals; internal safety/helpfulness score charts; "economically important tasks" wins/ties chart; HealthBench Hard Hallucinations (GPT-5 thinking 1.6 vs without 3.6, o3 12.9, GPT-4o 15.8, lower is better). Remaining GPT-4o comparison columns sit in the same charts. WebFetch 403 / web-reader soft-404; headless-browser extraction succeeded.
